questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the fourth number is related to the third number.

19 : 34 :: 5 : 6 :: 27 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

(First number × 2) - 4

 
• 19 : 34 → (19 × 2) - 4 = 38 - 4 = 34

and

 
• 5 : 6 → (5 × 2) - 4 = 10 - 4 = 6

Similarly,

 
• **27 : ? → (27 × 2) - 4 = 54 - 4 = 50**

Hence, the correct answer is **"50".**

questions.question:

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits.)

(4, 3, 16)

(6, 4, 28)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

(First number × Second number) + 4

 
• (4, 3, 16) → (4 × 3) + 4 = 12 + 4 = 16

and

 
• (6, 4, 28) → (6 × 4) + 4 = 24 + 4 = 28

Similarly,

 
• **(8, 2, 20) → (8 × 2) + 4 = 16 + 4 = 20**

**Hence, the correct answer is "(8, 2, 20)".**

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

17 × 4 + 6 ÷ 2 – 27 = 92
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) : + and ×

Given equation is : 17 × 4 + 6 ÷ 2 – 27 = 92

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 17 + 4 × 6 ÷ 2 - 27 = 92

⇒ 17 + 4 × __**6 ÷ 2**__ - 27 = 92

⇒ 17 + __**4 × 3**__ - 27 = 92

⇒ __**17 + 12**__ - 27 = 92

⇒ __**29 - 27**__ = 92

⇒ 2 ≠ 92

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : ÷ and ×

Given equation is : 17 × 4 + 6 ÷ 2 – 27 = 92

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 17 ÷ 4 + 6 × 2 - 27 = 92

⇒ __**17 ÷ 4**__ + 6 × 2 - 27 = 92

⇒ 4.25 + __**6 × 2**__ - 27 = 92

⇒ __**4.25 + 12**__ - 27 = 92

⇒ __**16**____**.25 - 27**__ = 92

⇒ 10.75 ≠ 92

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : + and -

Given equation is : 17 × 4 + 6 ÷ 2 – 27 = 92

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows: 17 × 4 - 6 ÷ 2 + 27 = 92

⇒ 17 × 4 - __**6 ÷ 2**__ + 27 = 92

⇒ __**17 × 4**__ - 3 + 27 = 92

⇒ __**68**__ - 3 __**+ 27**__ = 92

⇒ __**95 - 3**__ = 92

⇒ **92 = 92**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 4) : ÷ and +

Given equation is : 17 × 4 + 6 ÷ 2 – 27 = 92

After interchanging the two signs the equation is as follows : 17 × 4 ÷ 6 + 2 - 27 = 92

⇒ 17 × __**4 ÷ 6**__ + 2 - 27 = 92

⇒ __**17 × 0.66**__ + 2 - 27 = 92

⇒ __**11.33 + 2**__ - 27 = 92

⇒ __**13.33 - 27**__ = 92

⇒ 13.66 ≠ 92

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is** "+ and -".**

questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the following blanks, will complete the letter-series.

S _ U C T S R _ _ T _ R U E _ S R _ _ T

options.text: R U E S T V G
R V D S T U F
R U D S T U F
R V E S T U F

questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: S _ U C T S R _ _ T _ R U E _ S R _ _ T

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) R U E S T V G → S **R** U C / T S R **U /** **E** T **S **R / U E **T** S / R **V** **G** T →(Does not follow pattern).

Option 2) R V D S T U F → S **R** U C / T S R **V** / **D** T **S** R / U E **T** S / R **U** **F** T →(Does not follow pattern).

**Option 3) R U D S T U F **→ S **R** U C T / S R **U** **D **T / **S** R U E **T**/ S R **U** **F **T/ →(Follows pattern of SRU_T and +1 in the letter before T)

Option 4) R V E S T U F → S **R** U C / T S R **V /** **E** T **S** R / U E **T** S / R **U** **F** T → (Does not follow pattern).

Here, **'R U D S T U F'** followed a pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 3'.***

questions.question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. No streak is a line.

II. Some lines are bands.

III. All bands are flashes.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some flashes are streaks.

II. No flash is a line.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0c53c6f1491a80141fc53cb14754ed766837eec27c806b621277696a7df91ac.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some flashes are streaks → Does not follow (As no streak is a line, some lines are bands and all bands are flashes. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

II. No flash is a line → Does not follow (As some lines are bands and all bands are flashes. So, no direct relation is given between flash and line thus cannot be proved therefore it is definitely false)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (4)".
